I realize this is supposed to make him look hypocritical, but I don't see it that way. Elected representatives serve at the pleasure of their constituents, and government employees don't.

If Rubio spent his days just having water-gun fights in the Senate hallways, and his constituents are okay with that, that's their business. If his constituents don't like it, they can vote him out. Somebody is going to be in that Senate seat either way, so it's not like either choice will make a difference in how much money is spent.

But there's no such apparatus in place for dealing with regular employees, so in my eyes, it's a more serious issue when they dick around on the taxpayer dime, because there's nothing we as taxpayers can do about it.
